name: My Network
author: paulie420
description: Omarchy's built-in Wi-Fi/network panel, patched to verify a 'Limited internet access' verdict with its own unbound connectivity probe instead of just repainting NetworkManager's device-bound one -- so a VPN killswitch's false alarm shows fully normal, not a warning color, and a real outage still shows red. Also actively re-probes instead of trusting NetworkManager's stale connectivity cache.

barWidget.description: Wi-Fi list and connection state, self-verified against a false-restricted VPN killswitch signal.
